name: DevTrackerBySergio
description: Local-first editor activity analytics for Visual Studio Code.

commands.title: DevTracker: Set or Clear Weekly Goal
DevTracker: Back Up and Reset Data

devtracker.projectExclusionGlobs.description: Project path globs that DevTracker must not track.

devtracker.documentExclusionGlobs.description: Project-relative document globs that DevTracker must not track.

devtracker.detailedDataRetentionDays.description: Days to retain completed session detail. Daily aggregate rollups are retained.

devtracker.fileIdentityMode.description: How document identities are stored: project-relative paths, profile-salted hashes, or no document detail.

devtracker.gitTrackingEnabled.description: Collect local Git branch names, commit-event counts, and unique dirty-file aggregates. Data stays in DevTracker's local storage.

devtracker.debugTrackingEnabled.description: Collect local aggregate debug-session elapsed time and active time while debugging. Launch configuration and arguments are never stored.

devtracker.taskTrackingEnabled.description: Collect outcomes and monotonic durations for explicitly configured VS Code tasks. Disabled by default.

devtracker.trackedTasks.description: Exact VS Code task names eligible for tracking and their build or test classification. Commands, variables, terminals, and output are never read or stored.

configuredName.description: The exact task name shown by VS Code.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:extension && npm run typecheck:webview
scripts.test:performance: npm run compile-tests && mocha --ui tdd out/test/performanceBudgets.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && node ./scripts/run-integration-tests.js
scripts.test:webview: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && playwright test
scripts.test:webview:update: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && playwright test --update-snapshots
scripts.screenshots:product: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && node ./scripts/capture-product-screenshots.js
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:webview && npm run test:integration && npm run package:vsix && npm run validate:vsix && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
